match_note: Communications Physics file (transferred from another journal; only Comms Phys versions included). arXiv v1 (30 Apr 2026) still contains text the referees flagged and the rebuttal says was changed: the typo 'Together with the suppressed of ΔV2', 'Both devices show a superconducting critical current (IC) of 30 nA' without the critical-field distinction, and the width-independence sentence without the added reference to Ref. 7 and Fig. 5h. The revised-text quotes in the rebuttal (e.g. the expanded list of neglected effects in the CPD-density relation) are absent from v1.

concerns.quote: Fig. 1e. Please indicate the direction of the applied field, either in the caption or in main text.
concerns.summary: The field direction for Fig. 1e is not stated.

concerns.quote: Why there is a peak in the range of ~ -20mT to 0mT? Why the overall map has an asymmetry wrt the field direction?
concerns.summary: An unexplained feature near zero field and a field asymmetry in the dissipation maps of Fig. 4c,e need explaining.

concerns.quote: if available, showing the same map taken around point B would be much more convincing that dissipation directly probes superconductivity.
concerns.summary: A field-dependent dissipation map at the non-superconducting reference point B would be a control showing dissipation tracks superconductivity.

concerns.quote: this argument of channel-width independence needs some supporting evidence, e.g. reference to figures or previous reports.
concerns.summary: The claim that the superconducting channel width is independent of patterned channel width is unsupported as written.

concerns.quote: from Fig. 5h it seems the doping level of the whole 10nm-wide channel would not even reach within the SC dome.
concerns.summary: The edge-doping picture seems inconsistent with superconductivity in the 10 nm wide channels of Ref. 7; where the optimally doped region sits relative to the edge needs explaining.

concerns.quote: Is there any evidence of spatial inhomogeneity within the superconducting edge channels themselves? For example, are there observable variations in the β/α ratio along the channel direction?
concerns.summary: Asks whether the edge channel is homogeneous along its length, e.g. variation of beta/alpha.

concerns.quote: Could the authors clarify whether the conductive channels near the longitudinal edges of this 2D pattern exhibit this same 200 nm width?
concerns.summary: The 200 nm channel width is measured at one edge only; it should be checked at other edges of the pattern.

concerns.quote: the specific role and scientific relevance of this 1D channel to the scanning probe measurements presented in the main text are not clearly explained.
concerns.summary: The purpose of the patterned 1D channel in the device is not explained.

concerns.quote: While the use of εr = 25 for LAO is appropriate at room temperature, the dielectric properties of LAO may vary at 10 mK.
concerns.summary: The carrier density from Eq. (1) uses a room-temperature LAO dielectric constant, which may differ at 10 mK and shift the doping assignment.

concerns.quote: Please verify the statement regarding the critical current for both devices (lines 110–111).
concerns.summary: The critical-current statement for the two devices needs checking.

concerns.quote: The electronic schematics for the superconducting channel measurements (Supplementary Fig. 5) should be explicitly referenced in the corresponding main text sections
concerns.summary: Supplementary Fig. 5 should be cited in the main text.

concerns.quote: The coefficient Γ utilized in the axes of Figs. 4-5 should be clearly defined in the main text.
concerns.summary: The dissipation coefficient Gamma is not defined in the main text.

concerns.quote: the phrase “Together with the suppressed of ΔV2” should be corrected
The main scientific question is ... whether the interpretation uniquely establishes: 1. superconducting dissipation signatures
concerns.summary: Whether the quartic dissipation term uniquely signals superconductivity is an interpretation without a quantitative link to superconducting electrodynamics.

concerns.quote: While this interpretation is physically plausible and internally consistent, the current evidence remains indirect.
concerns.summary: The evidence for edge-localized intrinsic superconductivity with a proximitized interior is indirect.

concerns.quote: it relies on a simplified electrostatic model that neglects possible contributions from surface dipoles, nonlinear screening, and other electrostatic effects.
concerns.summary: The CPD-to-carrier-density conversion is semi-quantitative and its limitations should be discussed explicitly.
